title: The Lighthouse Keeper

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Old Mr. Gill keeps the lighthouse, all alone on the rocks. His light keeps every ship safe at night.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: We row out to him with fresh water each week. Would you please fill his jugs to their lines?

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Fill each jug to its line. Hold the big jug over a jug, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each jug to its line: full, half, three quarters, and a quarter.

feedback.too_full: Oops, that one's over the line. Tap it to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Every jug filled just right. Mr. Gill will be grateful!

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Mr. Gill keeps his light burning for strangers he'll never meet. That's a kind of love, isn't it?

journal_line: I filled water jugs for the lighthouse keeper with Captain Mara.
